name: @castellan/rust
//: Façade so turbo can see the Rust workspace's workspace-wide commands as ONE node in the repo-wide task graph (pathway's split): rustfmt, the Tauri app crates' clippy (they cannot be per-package — apps/desktop and apps/mobile are JS-face turbo packages already, and their src-tauri crates need the gtk stack), cargo-deny, coverage, codegen and the workspace-wide builds and checks stay here as single Cargo invocations. Per-crate nextest/clippy live in crates/*/package.json (@castellan/rust-*) so `turbo run test/lint --affected` selects changed crates and their dependents. Every script enters cargo through `pixi run cargo`; Turbo passes `PIXI_ENVIRONMENT` through so callers can select `default` or `shells` without a wrapper script. Cargo runs from the package directory and pixi resolves the repository manifest. `--workspace` is load-bearing: it covers the two Tauri app crates under apps/*/src-tauri as well as everything under crates/. `test` is deliberately absent: the turbo `test` verb runs the per-crate suites; `test:all` is the all-Rust bypass (nextest does not run doc-tests, so it is two invocations).

scripts.codegen: pixi run cargo run -p castellan-xtask -- codegen
scripts.lint: bun run lint:fmt && bun run lint:apps && bun run lint:deps
scripts.lint:apps: pixi run cargo clippy -p castellan-desktop -p castellan-mobile --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:deps: pixi run cargo deny --workspace check bans licenses sources
scripts.advisories: pixi run cargo deny --workspace check advisories
scripts.test:all: bun run test:unit:all && bun run test:doc:all
scripts.cov: pixi run cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --lcov --output-path crates/lcov.info
